reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The upgrade notes list this under 'Changed Metrics': the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state now appears as envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state.
consequence.remediation: Update any dashboards, recording rules or alerts that reference the old metric name to use envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state is exposed under the new name envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state, so anything that queries the old name needs review.
